description: Let the flagged transaction stand. No customer impact.
Decline the flagged authorization only. Card stays active. Low customer impact.
Card stays active; raise monitoring sensitivity for 72 hours. No customer impact.
Put other cards linked to the same device profile, region cluster, or ring under monitoring. No customer impact.
Send an informational message (e.g. a recurring charge reminder, a security tip). No customer impact.
Ask the cardholder whether they made the transaction. Card stays active pending reply. Low customer impact.
Require a one-time passcode or app confirmation before further activity. Low customer impact.
Block this card and reissue. High customer impact. L1 if exposure <= $2500, else L2.
Block every card the customer holds. Very high customer impact. Only when >=2 cards show confirmed fraud or credentials confirmed compromised (R10).
Write up the investigation for the internal record, without opening a case. No customer impact.
Open an internal fraud case with the evidence attached, and write it to the graph. No customer impact.
File a suspicious activity report with the regulator. Always requires fraud-manager approval.
Hand the case to a human analyst with the evidence. No customer impact.
Close the alert as legitimate. No customer impact.
